Nora (product): Pioneer Labs asked for a private-deploy roadmap that gives NetOps full control of routing and TLS, guarantees tenant IP pinning across minor upgrades, and a reproducible rollback. They want acceptance tests + cost impact by EOW.
Ben (eng-runtime): Short take: we can deliver a two-phase plan. Phase 1: customer-owned route tables + orchestrated DNS/TLS handoff + canary promotion + rollback playbook. Phase 2: strict IP pinning (retain exact tenant IPs) + installer/CNI changes + cert rotation automation. Phase1 ~3w, Phase2 ~6w.
Rina (field): Pioneer requires <30s packet loss during cutover and wants TLS private key custody (KMS-backed) with rotation audit logs. Also they asked for a test harness that simulates BGP failover.
Omar (solutions): For Phase1 propose a "route-claim" flow: customer advertises prefixes, we validate, then orchestrate DNS TTL drop, TLS handoff (ACME-style or KMS import), and staged canary shifts. We'll supply runbook and simple harness. Example commands: ```
# validate canary path
curl -H "Host: pioneer-canary" https://private.pioneer/healthz
# promote canary
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/promote -d '{"tenant":"pioneer-canary"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"tenant":"pioneer-canary"}'
```
Ben (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: need flags: `route_ownership: customer|redwood`, `ip_pinning: soft|strict`. Soft pinning lets tenant CIDR preserved but IPs may shift; strict requires allocator and CNI changes (Phase2). Also need TLS handoff API to accept KMS-wrapped keys or ACME proofs.
Nora (product): Proposal: ship Phase1 (Q3): customer route ownership, DNS/TLS handoff automation, canary + rollback APIs, runbook, and acceptance test harness. Defer strict IP pinning + installer/CNI changes to Phase2 (Q4). We'll present a short SLA draft (upgrade window & packet-loss bounds) to legal for sign-off.
Rina (field): Pioneer will accept Phase1 if we deliver: (1) NetOps handoff doc with exact verification steps, (2) end-to-end staging playbook they can run, (3) cost estimate for reserved capacity + TLS rotation labor. I'll capture exact packet-loss SLA numbers from their ops lead.
Omar (solutions): I'll author the runbook template and a harness that supports BGP failover simulation and TLS import. Sample verification snippet: ```
# simulate traffic mirror
curl -H "Host: pioneer-canary" https://staging.pioneer/healthz
# swap cert via API
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/tls/import -d '{"tenant":"pioneer","kms_key":"projects/pioneer/keys/rls"}'
```
doc-bot: Draft created: /docs/private-deploys/pioneer-handoff-draft.md. Owner: Omar. Reviewers: Ben, Rina.
Ben (eng-runtime): Dependencies: installer must accept customer route tables and static VIP mapping; CNI changes required for Phase2 IP pinning. I'll open RFCs for both this sprint. If BGP isn't possible for a customer, fallback is managed peering + controlled DNS/TLS cutover.
Nora (product): Action items: Omar to deliver runbook + harness by Wed, Ben to publish RFCs and prototype flags by Fri, Rina to confirm Pioneer SLA thresholds and cost asks by Thu. We'll slot Phase1 into Q3 roadmap and mark Phase2 conditional on telemetry and one successful customer rollout. If anything slips, escalate to PM leadership. :white_check_mark:
